effects.name: Control
effects.text: If your Magi is Agram, you may play any cards that specifically say that they can be played by a Shadow Magi. Agram does not pay a regional penalty for non-Core cards.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ainjer loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grr
powers.text: Discard Ainjer from play. Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature for each of your Bograth Creatures in play. Opposing cards do not affect Grr when it is used and cannot alter the amount of energy discarded by Grr. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.

name: Ainjer Swarm
text: If you have at least four Bograth Creatures in play, all opposing Creatures in play lose one energy.

effects.name: Super Clever
effects.text: Korg cannot play Relics.

effects.name: Super Brave
effects.text: Whenever Korg has no energy, he is defeated, even if he has Creatures in play.

name: All-High King Korg
sub type: Celebrated Emperor of Great and Mighty Bograth
text: Korg can only play Core, Bograth, and Universal cards.

powers.name: Energy Boost
powers.text:
Roll one die.
1, 2, or 3 = Your opponents add one energy
to each of their Creatures in play.
4 or 5 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add two energy to the chosen Creature.
6 = Choose any one Creature in play.
Add four energy to the chosen Creature.

name: Ancient's Puzzlebox

powers.name: Mind Games
powers.text: Discard Ancient's Puzzlebox from play. Reveal any number of cards in your hand and choose a Creature. Add one energy to it for each Ancient's Puzzlebox you reveal. Draw a card. You may not play another Ancient's Puzzlebox this turn.

text: Your deck may contain up to six copies of Ancient Puzzlebox.

effects.name: Weave Twist
effects.text: All cards that specifically reference Core instead reference their own region. If a card is of multiple regions, you choose which of those regions to reference.

effects.name: Hordes
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, you may discard one energy from Baa to draw an additional card at the end of the turn.

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, if your Magi is Bograth, you may play one copy of Black Stuff from your discard pile, paying all costs.

effects.name: Bleph Fu
effects.text: Whenever Bleph attacks a Creature, before energy is removed, add one energy to Bleph for each of the defending player's Creatures.

powers.name: Waking Dreams
powers.text: Choose up to three different Bograth Creatures in your discard pile and play each of them with one energy instead of its normal starting energy. An opposing player immediately discards any one of those Creatures from play. Those Creatures cannot attack this turn.

name: Bog Stench
text: Until the end of your next turn, you are considered to have two additional Bograth Creatures in play for all of your Spells, Powers, and Effects.

effects.name: Dream Draft
effects.text: Whenever an opponent plays a Relic, if your Magi is Bograth or Orothe, you may immediately play Bog Wellisk from your hand, ignoring all costs. You may play one Bog Wellisk in this way per turn.

powers.name: Lore
powers.text: Draw one card.

powers.name: Intimidation
powers.text: Discard one of your Creatures from play. Choose an opposing Creature and move half of its energy, rounded up, to Brog, Swamp Thug.

effects.name: Shiftier
effects.text: Your Creatures lose no energy from opposing Effects.

effects.name: Defense
effects.text: If Cave Rudwot is attacked, add two energy to it before energy is removed.

powers.name: Pump You Up
powers.text: Choose a Burrowed Creature or a Creature with the Effect "Invulnerability". Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy. Skip your Draw step this turn.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Core and Weave Spells and Powers do not affect Chaos Flugg.

name: Chaos Flugg

powers.name: Dark Demanding
powers.text: Discard Chaos Flugg from play. Discard all Core and all Weave Creatures from play.

text: Weave Magi can play Chaos Flugg.

effects.name: Guile
effects.text: Whenever Chaos Plith defeats a Creature in an attack, draw a card. If Evu is your Magi, draw an additional card.

name: Chaos Plith
text: Naroom Magi may play Chaos Plith.

name: Cleansing
text: Name any one non-Magi Core cards. For the rest of this game, all cards of the name are Kybar's Teeth or Underneath, your choice, instead of Core.

effects.name: Betrayal
effects.text: Whenever you gain control of an opposing card, choose any one Core or Orothe card in your discard pile and place it into your hand.

name: Corathan
text: Orothe Magi can play Corathan.

name: Corrupt
text: Choose any one Magi in play. Attack Corrupt to the chosen Magi. If the chosen Magi is discarded from play, discard Corrupt from play. When a Creature is played by any Magi, discard Corrupt from play. The Creature played becomes a Core Creature instead of its original region, and your Magi gains control of that Creature.

name: Creeping Ainjer

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Bograth Creature. Remove one energy from it and add three energy to your Magi.

text:
Creeping Ainjer's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi can play Creeping Ainjer.

effects.name: Mostly Regal Presence
effects.text: All non-Core, non-Bograth Creatures in play lose one energy, before energy is removed, whenever they attack one of your Bograth Creatures.

name: Crushing Darkness
text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard four energy from the chosen Creature. If this discards the cosen Creature from play, play it as a Core Creature with half of its starting energy, rounded up, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot attack or use any of its Powers this turn. Shadow Magi cannot play this Spell.

name: Crushing Will
text: Choose a Creature and remove four energy from it. If this discards the Creature from play, choose up to two non-Universal Relics and discard them from play.  Only Universal and Universal Shadow Magi can play Crushing Will.

powers.name: Healing Light
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Discard Crystal Arboll from play. Add two energy to the chosen Creature. If the chosen Creature is Underneath, add two additional energy.

effects.name: Renew
effects.text: After a Crystal Creature is discarded from play on an opposing turn, draw a card.

effects.name: Ricochet
effects.text: Once per turn, as Crystal Hyren is attacked, remove one energy from each opposing Creature.

powers.name: Illuminate
powers.text: Choose a Spell in play and discard it.

effects.name: Anti-Magic
effects.text: Crystal Parmalag is not affected by opposing Spells, Powers, or Effects that specifically discard Creatures from play. Your Spells, Powers, and Effects may not prevent Crystal Parmalag from losing energy.

effects.name: Regenerate
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Saris was not attacked, add two energy to it.

name: Crystal Shield
text: Choose one of your Creatures and attach Crystal Shield to it. While Crystal Shield is attached, the Creature gains Effect - Deflect: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses this Creature, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead. Discard Crystal Shield from play.

effects.name: Dream Charge
effects.text: At the end of each opponent's turn, if Crystal Twinklet was not attacked, draw a card.

effects.name: Deflect
effects.text: Once per turn, as an opposing Spell or Power chooses Crystal Twinklet, you may choose another Creature that could have been chosen by that Spell or Power. The Spell or Power chooses that Creature instead.

effects.name: Dream Inversion
effects.text: Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that discard energy from Dagok instead add an equal amount of energy. Opposing Spells, Powers, and other Effects that add energy to Dagok instead discard an equal amount of energy.

name: Dagok
text: Naroom Magi can play Dagok. Naroom Shadow Magi can play Dagok for one less energy.

name: Dark Ayebaw

powers.name: Implode
powers.text: Choose any one Creature or Magi in play. Discard Dark Ayebaw from play, and discard X Core and/or Arderial cards from your hand. Discard X+2 energy from the chosen Creature or Magi.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Ayebaw.

name: Dark Portents
text: Choose a player. Reveal the top five cards of the chosen player's deck. Add one energy to your Magi for each Creature revealed. You may discard one of the revealed cards. Put the remaining cards back on the chosen player's deck in the same order.

name: Dark Vellup

powers.name: Purge
powers.text: Discard a card from your hand and draw a card. If a copy of the card you discarded is in play, draw an extra card.

text: Arderial Magi may play Dark Vellup.

powers.name: Subvert
powers.text: Choose any one hyren in play. Gain control of the chosen hyren. That hyren may not attack this turn.

effects.name: Tunneling Attack
effects.text: Your burrowed Creatures may attack as normal.

name: Dream Rift
text: Take all Creature cards from your discard pile and shuffle them into your decK. Draw three cards. Arderial Magi may play Dream Rift.

effects.name: Condemn
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your opponent's turns, you may choose any one Creature in play. Until the end of that opponent's turn, each time the chosen Creature loses energy from Powers, Spells, or attacks, it loses three additional energy.

name: Dryte Fiend
text: Cald Magi may play Dryte Fiend.

effects.name: Grim Reflection
effects.text: At the beginning of each player's Draw step, if that player has more cards in his or her hand than any other player, that player draws one less card this turn. While Ebony Mirror is in play, all players draw at least one card during their Draw step.

effects.name: Sabotage
effects.text: When Emaal is defeated, discard all energy from all opposing Magi and draw a card.

effects.name: Imaginary Friends
effects.text: You are considered to have three additional Bograth Creatures in play for all of your Spells, Powers and Effects.

name: Entrench
text: Choose a Creature and attach Entrench to it. While Entrench is attached, the Creature gains "Effect - Entrenched: As this Creature is attacked, add two energy to it. This Creature may not attack." A Creature may not have more than one Entrench attached.

effects.name: Discordia
effects.text: Once per turn, when an opposing Magi plays a non-Universal Creature not of their Magi's region, you may choose and discard one of that Magi's Creatures from play.

effects.name: Devour
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Creature is discarded from play or reduced to zero energy by one of your cards, draw a card.

name: Evil Evu
text: You may play Naroom cards, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties.

effects.name: Affinity
effects.text: Fiend of Furoks ignores regional penalties and restrictions when playing Furoks.

effects.name: Reconstruct
effects.text: Once per turn, you can play a Furok from your discard pile as if it were in your hand, paying all costs.

powers.name: Strengthen
powers.text: Choose any one of your Creatures in play. Discard a card from your hand to add two energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Talisman
effects.text: If you have an Amulet of Ombor in play, you can play Gate to Ombor from your hand or from your deck, ignoring all costs. Add one to all die rolls you make for Amulet of Ombor (die rolls of 6 remain 6).
Gate to Ombor cannot be discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Relics from play. Discard Gate to Ombor from play if your Magi is not an Underneath Magi.

powers.name: Guard
powers.text: Search your deck for one of your Magi's starting Creatures. Play that Creature, reducing its cost by five energy, to a minimum of zero. That Creature can never attack.

effects.name: Glow
effects.text: All of your Creatures can attack while burrowed.

effects.name: Impede
effects.text: All players draw one less card during their Draw Step.

name: Gia Pet

powers.name: Power Siphon
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Spell in play. Gia Pet gains energy equal to the energy cost of the chosen Spell.

text: Weave Magi can play Gia Pet. Non-Core, non-Weave Magi cannot play Gia Pet.

powers.name: Withdraw
powers.text: Giant Parmalag cannot be attacked until after your next turn.

effects.name: Dream Blur
effects.text: All of your Bograth Creatures in play are also Core. All of your Core Creatures in play are also Bograth.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Glablit loses no energy from opposing Effects.

effects.name: Paydirt
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures defeats an opposing Creature in an attack, draw a card.

name: Golthub

powers.name: Mire
powers.text: Choose any one region. Defeat Golthub. Discard all non-Magi cards of the chosen region from play.

text: Golthub can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.

powers.name: Chain Whip
powers.text: Choose a Creature or Magi with more than its printed starting energy. Remove three energy from it.

effects.name: Melancholy
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures loses energy from an opposing Spell or Power, add one energy to Gragling.

effects.name: Lonely
effects.text: If you have another Creature in play, Gragling gains '"energize": 1'.

effects.name: Share
effects.text: Whenever you play a Bograth Creature, choose any one Bograth Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Transform
effects.text: When you reveal Grahnna, if your previous Magi was Wiep, place any one Bograth card from your discard pile into your hand.

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: On all opponents' turns, Granas is burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Pummel
effects.text: Whenever Granas attacks a Creature, Granas removes an additional energy from the defending Creature.

effects.name: Enduring Renewal
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures is discarded from play, you may discard one energy from your Magi to draw a card.

powers.name: Parasitic Growth
powers.text: Discard Gremble from play. Discard your hand and draw three cards.

powers.name: Dreamform
powers.text: Choose any one other Grubble in play. Discard both this Grubble and the chosen Grubble from play. Search your deck for any one Creature and play that Creature with its starting energy.

powers.name: Fortify
powers.text: Add two energy to each Creature you control that defeated a Creature in an attack this turn.

effects.name: Night's Shade
effects.text: Once per turn, when a Creature is discarded from play, choose a Creature. Discard two energy from the chosen Creature.

name: Gumph
text: Naroom Magi can play Gumph.

effects.name: Vile Herald
effects.text: Bograth Magi and Core Magi can play both Core Creatures and Bograth Creatures, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: If Gwaeg is defeated while defending, place it into your hand instead of your discard pile.

name: Gwaeg
text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Gwaeg.

effects.name: Digging Mastery
effects.text: Each of your Underneath Creatures in play loses no more than two energy each time it is attacked.

name: Harban

powers.name: Browbeat
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play with only one energy. Gain control of the chosen Creature.

text: Arderial Magi may play Harban.

effects.name: Starfire
effects.text: Magi can retrieve, but not play, their starting cards. Your cards cannot force other players to discard cards from their hands.
If any opposing Magi are Core, decrease Harror, Nightstalker's energy by two.

name: Haunt
text: Choose an opposing Creature. Attach Haunt to the chosen Creature. When that Creature is discarded, play it instead, ignoring all costs and regional restrictions. The Creature becomes Core instead of its original region(s). The Creature cannot attack the turn you play it.

name: Haunting Visions
text: Choose an opposing Creature and attach Haunting Visions to it. The Creature may not be chosen by its controller's Spells and Powers.

name: Hidden Door
text: Search your deck for up to two Underneath Relics and place them into your hand.

effects.name: Dreamfetch
effects.text: Whenever you play an Underneath Spell that does not remain in play, you may discard Hubram from play to put the Spell into your hand instead of your discard pile.

name: Impact
text: Choose any one of your Creatures and any one Magi in play. Discard twice as much energy as the chosen Creature has from the chosen Magi. Discard the chosen Creature from play.

effects.name: Vitalize
effects.text: All of your Jiles and Bograth Creatures in play gain energize: 1.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Jile loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Nourish
powers.text: Add one energy to each of your other burrowed Creatures.

powers.name: Daze
powers.text: Choose a Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature may not gain energy until the beginning of your next turn.

effects.name: Nightmare
effects.text: When you play Koil, choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Re-Koil
effects.text: If Koil is defeated in any attack, after it is discarded from play, choose any one player's discard pile. Shuffle the chosen discard pile into its owner's deck.

effects.name: Korg
effects.text: Korg & Zet may play no more than two cards each turn and may not play Relics.

effects.name: Zet
effects.text: Whenever one of your Creatures attacks, once per attack, one of your other Creatures may join in the attack. The defending Creature's player chooses one of your attacking Creatures to lose energy in the attack.

name: Korg & Zet
text: Korg & Zet count as two Magi for deck construction.

powers.name: Hatred
powers.text: Remove two energy from each opposing Creature. Remove one extra energy from each d'Resh Creature.

effects.name: Regroup
effects.text: If Looph attacks and is defeated, you may immediately play a Bograth Creature from your hand, paying all costs.

name: Maelstrom
text:
Discard X energy from each opposing Magi in play.
Orothe Magi may play Maelstrom.

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Mist Hyren's cost is reduced by one for each of your Creatures in play.
Mist Hyren can only be played during your Play Creatures Step.

powers.name: Retrieve
powers.text: Discard Moob from play. Add one energy to your Magi for each of your Bograth Creatures in play.

effects.name: Martyr
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, you may discard any one of your Bograth Creatures from play. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

name: Moob Ring
text: If an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect causes you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard Moob Ring from your hand or from play instead. If you do, until your current Magi is defeated, no opposing cards can cause you to discard cards from your hand.

powers.name: Theft
powers.text: Choose any one Relic in play. Gain control of the chosen Relic for your next X turns. At the end of X turns, or if Morag is defeated, return that Relic to its owner's hand.

powers.name: Dark Secrets
powers.text: Discard Moss Quido from play. Draw one card for each of your Bograth or Core Creatures in play, whichever is greater. Use this Power only before your Attack Step.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Multiply
powers.text: If you control another Trulb, move one energy from each opposing Magi to Moss Trulb.

powers.name: Depression
powers.text: Choose two Bograth Creatures. Move up to five energy from one Creature to the other Creature.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Muck Vinoc loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Grapple
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play with seven or more energy. Discard Muck Vinoc and the chosen Creature from play.

name: Mud Bubble
text: Choose a Bograth Creature in your discard pile. Place that Creature in your hand. If you play one or more copies of that Creature this turn, draw a card at the end of your turn.

powers.name: Burrow
powers.text: Discard Muggum from play. Choose any two Bograth and/or Underneath Creatures in play. Until the end of your next turn, both chosen Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and opposing Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Myka loses no more than two energy from each opposing Spell, Power or attack.

powers.name: Horrible Dreams
powers.text: Choose an opposing Creature. The chosen Creature gains 'Effect — Toss and Turn: At the beginning of your turn, discard one energy from your Magi and each of your Creatures in play. This Creature removes two less energy from Core Creatures in attacks.'

name: Ninibom
text: If your defeated Magi are Baa, Wiep, and Grannah, in that order, you can play Ninibom as a fourth Magi. You do not lose the game until Ninibom is defeated. If Ninibom is not your fourth Magi, increase Ninibom's energize to seven. Ninibom can only play Bograth, Core, and Universal cards.

effects.name: Resilience
effects.text: Your Creatures cannot be reduced below one energy by opposing Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Ooze Arboll loses no energy from opposing Effects.

powers.name: Amplify
powers.text: Discard Ooze Arboll from play. Add one energy to each of your Bograth Creatures in play.

powers.name: Devastate
powers.text: Discard all non-Underneath Creatures from play.

powers.name: Shield
powers.text: Parmalag is prevented from losing any energy from attacks until the end of your turn.

powers.name: Ring Testing
powers.text: Play a Bograth Creature from your hand, ignoring all costs. That Creature cannot attack this turn. At the end of your turn, discard energy from Phlouk equal to the Creature's starting energy. If you don't have enough energy on Phlouk, discard the Creature from play.

effects.name: Light Barrier
effects.text: Opposing Creatures with less energy than Phosphor Hyren cannot attack your non-Hyren Underneath Creatures. Phosphor Hyren cannot be burrowed.

effects.name: Stabilize
effects.text: As one of your Creatures is attacked, add one energy to it.

name: Pillar Hyren
text: If your Magi is Underneath, Pillar Hyren may not be discarded from play by opposing Spells, Powers or Effects while it still has energy. Your Powers, Spells and Effects cannot reduce the amount of energy removed from Pillar Hyren in attacks.

effects.name: Leadership
effects.text: When you play Pyder, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder. Whenever you energize, move all but one energy from your Magi to Pyder.

effects.name: Summoning
effects.text: Whenever you play a Creature, discard energy from Pyder to play the Creature. All of your Bograth Creatures cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Pylofuf is burrowed; it cannot attack and loses no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponents' Spells and Powers.

name: Pylofuf
text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Pylofuf.

effects.name: Calling
effects.text: Quido Swarm's starting energy is equal to the number of your other Paradwyn and Bograth Creatures in play.

effects.name: Swarm
effects.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, restore Quido Swarm to its starting energy.

powers.name: Leech
powers.text: Choose any two Creatures in play. Discard X energy from one of the chosen Creatures. Add X energy to the other chosen Creature.

effects.name: Counterattack
effects.text: Immediately after one of your cards is attacked, you may play Rabid Wasperine, paying all costs. If your Magi is Naroom Shadow, add one energy to Rabid Wasperine when you play it. Rabid Wasperine immediately attacks the opposing Creature that just attacked.

name: Rabid Wasperine
text: Naroom Magi can play Rabid Wasperine.

powers.name: Refresh
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature. Add two additional energy if the chosen Creature is a Parmalag.

name: Resonate
text: Choose any or all of the following: Choose any one Relic in play. Discard the chosen Relic from play. OR Choose any one Creature in play. Discard one energy from the chosen Creature. OR Choose any one Magi in play. Discard two energy from the chosen Magi. For each action chosen, Resonate's cost is increased by one.

effects.name: Tinker
effects.text: Whenever you play a Relic, choose any one Creature in play. Add one energy to the chosen Creature.

effects.name: Ancestral Favor
effects.text: Your Spells cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Blight
effects.text: After an opponent plays a Creature with more energy than Rot Arboll, move one energy from that Creature to Rot Arboll.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: This Creature loses no energy from opposing Effects.

effects.name: Myth
effects.text: Rous cannot be attacked. If all of your Creatures in play are Rous, discard Rous from play.

name: Rous

powers.name: Hit
powers.text: Choose one opposing Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Rous.

text: Only Bograth Magi or Core Magi can play Rous.

powers.name: Mini-Quake
powers.text: Remove one energy from each non-Underneath Creature and Magi.

powers.name: Secrets
powers.text: Choose any one opposing player. The chosen player reveals his or her hand to all players. Draw one card for each Creature revealed, and one card for each non-Creature Naroom card revealed.

name: Severos

powers.name: Mind Dredge
powers.text: Choose a Creature in an opponent's discard pile. Play the chosen Creature, ignoring regional restrictions and penalties. Pay all costs from Severos instead of your Magi. Use this Power only after the Attack step. When that Creature leaves play, discard Severos from play.

text: Orothe Magi can play Severos

powers.name: Vitalize
powers.text: Choose any one Core Creature in play. Discard Shadow Bones from play. Add energy to the chosen Creature equal to that Creature's starting energy.

powers.name: Protection
powers.text: Each of your Core Creatures in play is not affected by non-Core Spells and Powers until the end of your next turn. You may not use Shadow Cloak on your next turn.

effects.name: Descendance
effects.text: After Shadow Dryte defeats a Creature while attacking, add four energy to Shadow Dryte.

effects.name: Feed
effects.text: After a Furok is discarded from play, you may play one copy of Shadow Fird from your discard pile, ignoring all costs.

powers.name: Absolute Authority
powers.text: Discard a Core card from your hand. Add one energy to your Magi and one energy to each of your Core Creatures. If your Magi is Agram, add one extra energy to each of your Core Creatures.

powers.name: Demand
powers.text: If you have four or more Bograth Creatures in play, draw a card.

powers.name: Shriveled Dreams
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Creature has a starting energy of one instead of its normal starting energy.

powers.name: Grand Nightmares
powers.text: Choose any one Creature in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Creature has a starting energy of ten instead of its normal starting energy.

name: Slinking Greal

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Core Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature's controller chooses a Creature he or she controls and removes two energy from it.

text:
Slinking Greal's text cannot be altered.
Non-Core Magi may play Slinking Greal.

effects.name: Vile Memories
effects.text: Sorrowing Ogar can play all Core cards ignoring regional penalties and restrictions. Core cards that Sorrowing Ogar plays are considered Underneath instead of Core.

effects.name: Regret
effects.text: All Core cards cost opposing Magi one additional energy to play.

name: Sorrowing Ogar
text: Sorrowing Ogar may not be played in a deck with any Core Magi.

name: Spirit Drain
text: Choose any one player. Discard energy from the chosen player's Magi equal to the number of cards in that player's hand.

effects.name: Pack Defense
effects.text: Whenever one of your other Creatures is attacked, Striped Korrit may defend with that Creature. Striped Korrit loses no energy in the attack, but removes energy from the attacker as normal.

effects.name: Nightmare Gate
effects.text: All of your other Core and Bograth cards cost one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

name: Swamp Hyren
text: Core Magi may play Swamp Hyren.

effects.name: Betrayed Secrets
effects.text: Effects may not reduce the amount of energy removed from opposing Creatures in attacks.

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: Your Core Creatures remove one extra energy when attacking.

effects.name: Dreamwarp
effects.text: As you play Taglat, increase or decrease its starting energy by up to one, to a minimum starting energy of one, until the end of the turn.

powers.name: Dream Cross
powers.text: Choose any one Power or Effect on an opposing card in play. Until the beginning of your next turn, the chosen Power or Effect is considered to be printed on Taglat. Taglat cannot copy a Power or Effect that it already has. All copied Powers that reference the card that they are printed on now reference Taglat.

effects.name: Leech
effects.text: At the beginning of your Play Creatures step, you may discard two energy from The Real Qwade. If you do, until the end of your turn, whenever you play a Creature, choose another Creature. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to the Creature you just played.

name: The Real Qwade
text: The Real Qwade can be in a Magi stack with "Qwade". When you reveal The Real Qwade, defeat him if your previous defeated Magi was not "Qwade".

name: Thunderquake
text: Choose any number of Creatures in play. Discard a total of X energy in any combination from the chosen Creatures. X cannot be more than 10.

effects.text: Tomes of the Great Library cannot be discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Relics from play. Discard Tomes of the Great Library from play if your Magi is not a Naroom Magi or Naroom Shadow Magi.

powers.name: Research
powers.text: Search your deck or any opposing discard pile for any one Spell. Play the chosen Spell, ignoring regional restrictions. If that Spell came from your deck, discard it. If it came from an opposing discard pile, shuffle it into its owner's deck.

effects.text: Whenever an opposing Power, Spell or Effect forces you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you may discard one energy from your Magi. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

effects.name: Lore
effects.text: Once during your Draw Step, after you draw, you may discard one card from your hand. If you do, draw one card.

name: Tomorrow's Jewel
text: If an opposing card causes you to discard Tomorrow's Jewel from your hand or from play, you my play it instead.

effects.name: Lifetap
effects.text: Whenever a Spell or Power adds energy to one or more Creatures in play, add one energy to Trask.

name: Trask
text: Orothe Magi may play Trask.

effects.name: Watchful
effects.text: Whenever an opposing Spell, Power, or Effect discards energy from one or more of your Creatures in play, you may discard Treepsh from play. If you do, the Spell, Power, or Effect does nothing.

powers.name: Supply
powers.text: Discard Treepsh from play. Draw a card. If you have more Creatures in play than any one opponent of your choice, draw an additional card.

effects.name: Inspire
effects.text: Draw two additional cards during your Draw step. Reduce your Magi's Energize by two.

effects.name: Frightened
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, any Core Magi may discard three energy to discard Trogovo.

powers.name: Sweet Sorrow
powers.text: Discard one of your Trulbs from play. Draw a number of cards equal to the Trulb's printed starting energy, plus one.

name: Trulbble!
text: Discard up to four Trulbs you control from play. Draw two cards for each Trulb you discarded.

effects.name: Avenger
effects.text: If Trygar is defeated, at the end of the current turn you may play any Creature from your hand. Play three energy on the Creature instead of its normal starting energy. Until the beginning of your next turn, the Creature played is unaffected by your opponents' cards.

effects.name: Legacy
effects.text: When your Magi is defeated, choose an opponent and two of that player's non-Magi cards in play. The chosen player chooses and discards one of the chosen cards.

name: Trygar's Will
text: Korremar can play Trygar's Will.

effects.name: Burrow
effects.text: Your other Underneath Creatures are burrowed; they cannot attack and each lose no more than two energy per turn from attacks and your opponent's Spells and Powers.

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the end of each of your turns, add one energy to each burrowed Creature in play.

name: Turn
text: Choose any one Creature in play with less than its starting energy. X is the chosen Creature's starting energy. The chosen Creature becomes Core and you gain control of it. Restore the chosen Creature to its starting energy.

name: Twisted Dreams
text: Choose a Power on an opposing Creature. Remove energy from that Creature equal to the cost of the chosen Power (X equals zero).

effects.name: Resistance
effects.text: Korrits you control may not be chosen by opposing Powers.

effects.name: Fungal Bloom
effects.text: After you play a Korrit, add one energy to it.

effects.name: Crystal Affinity
effects.text: Crystal cards cost you one less energy to play, to a minimum of one.

effects.name: Resist
effects.text: Your Crystal Creatures lose one less energy when attacked.

effects.name: Mud Clod
effects.text: When Umbu is discarded from play, choose a Relic in play. Attach Umbu to the chosen Relic; as long as Umbu is attached, it cannot be discarded by having zero energy and is unaffected by cards that affect Creatures. None of the chosen Relic's Powers or Effects can be used. At the beginning of each of your turns, discard one energy from that Relic's Magi. When the Relic is discarded, discard Umbu.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Umbu loses no energy from opposing Effects.

name: Unmake
text: Choose a Creature with X energy. Discard the chosen Creature from play. Discard one energy from each Creature in play of the same type as the discarded Creature.

effects.name: Tainted Dreams
effects.text: Your Magi may play Core Spells, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

name: Urhail
text: Underneath Shadow Magi may play Urhail, ignoring regional penalties and restrictions.

effects.name: Surge
effects.text: As you play Vard, if your Magi is Bograth and any opponent has more Creatures in play than you (not counting this card), ignore Vard's cost.

effects.name: Shifty
effects.text: Vard loses no energy from opposing Effects.

name: Vard Stampede
text: Choose any one Magi in play. If you have at least four Bograth Creatures in play, discard all of the chosen Magi's Relics and Spells from play.

name: Venomous Korrit

powers.name: Skulk
powers.text: Choose an opposing Underneath Creature and remove one energy from it. That Creature gains "Effect - Weaken: As this Creature is attacked, remove two energy from it." until the end of your next turn.

text:
Venomous Korrit's text cannot be altered.
Core Magi may play Venomous Korrit.

powers.name: Plague
powers.text: Choose a Creature type. All Creatures of the chosen type lose two energy.

effects.name: Transform
effects.text: When you reveal Wiep, if your previous Magi was Baa, place any one Bograth card from your discard pile into your hand.

powers.name: Power Drain
powers.text: Choose any Power on an opposing Creature. Move energy equal to the cost of the chosen Power from that Creature to Wiep.

effects.name: Sweet Rot
effects.text: If Wither Twee is defeated in an attack, add one energy to each Bograth Creature and draw a card.

effects.name: Seeds of Deceit
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a Spell or Relic in an opposing discard pile and shuffle it into its owner's deck. Increase Yayek's energize by that card's energy cost until the end of your turn (X equals zero).

powers.name: Thump Thump Wham!
powers.text: Discard one of your Bograth Creatures from play. Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Discard energy from the chosen Creature equal to the number of your Bograth Creatures in play.

effects.name: Good Riddance
effects.text: If Korg is in any player's defeated Magi pile, add three energy to Zet's starting energy.

powers.name: Treachery
powers.text: Zet gains control of any one Creature in play. X is the amount of energy on that Creature. If the Creature is a non-Core Creature, it loses one energy. The Creature may not attack this turn.

name: Zungg

powers.name: Gnaw
powers.text: Choose any one opposing Creature in play. Move one energy from the chosen Creature to Zungg.

text: Only Bograth or Core Magi can play Zungg.

name: Zungg Swarm
text: Choose any one Magi in play. If you have at least seven Bograth Creatures and seven Core Creatures in play, discard energy equal to the number of your Bograth Creatures in play from all of the chosen Magi's Creatures.

effects.name: Strengthen
effects.text: At the end of your turn, add one energy to each of your burrowed and illusionary Creatures that attacked this turn.

effects.name: Escape
effects.text: Your burrowed and illusionary Creatures that are discarded from play by opposing cards that specifically discard Creatures from play are instead returned to your hand.
